allow: Read-only inspection inside the current ikimetr-realtor-collector repository
Editing ordinary source and test files only inside the current repository
Running pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build, and pnpm --filter @ikimetr/web test:smoke
deny: Any access outside the current ikimetr-realtor-collector repository
Any package installation or dependency change
Any Git mutation including commit, push, checkout, switch, reset, clean, merge, rebase, or branch changes
Any destructive, privileged, persistence, credential, or secret-related operation

environment: The current safety branch and verified bundle backup must be preserved
